@@ -69,6 +69,10 @@ profile {{.Name}} flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {
   signal (receive) peer={{.DaemonProfile}},
   # Container processes may send signals amongst themselves.
   signal (send,receive) peer={{.Name}},
+  # With kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_unconfined=1, an unprivileged
+  # profile change is converted to stacking, producing "{{.Name}}//&unconfined".
+  # Allow signals to peers with this stacked label as well.
+  signal (send,receive) peer={{.Name}}//&unconfined,
 {{if .RootlessKit}}
   # https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/issues/2730
   signal (receive) peer={{.RootlessKit}},
@@ -96,6 +100,8 @@ profile {{.Name}} flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {
   # allow processes within the container to trace each other,
   # provided all other LSM and yama setting allow it.
   ptrace (trace,tracedby,read,readby) peer={{.Name}},
+  # Same stacked-label peer as the signal rule above.
+  ptrace (trace,tracedby,read,readby) peer={{.Name}}//&unconfined,
 }

 package apparmor
 
 import (
+	"bytes"
 	"testing"
 
 	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 )
 
+func TestDefaultProfileAllowsUnconfinedStackedPeers(t *testing.T) {
+	var buf bytes.Buffer
+	err := generate(&data{Name: "cri-containerd.apparmor.d"}, &buf)
+	assert.NoError(t, err)
+	prof := buf.String()
+	assert.Contains(t, prof, "signal (send,receive) peer=cri-containerd.apparmor.d//&unconfined,")
+	assert.Contains(t, prof, "ptrace (trace,tracedby,read,readby) peer=cri-containerd.apparmor.d//&unconfined,")
+	assert.Contains(t, prof, "signal (send,receive) peer=cri-containerd.apparmor.d,")
+	assert.Contains(t, prof, "ptrace (trace,tracedby,read,readby) peer=cri-containerd.apparmor.d,")
+	assert.NotContains(t, prof, "//&*")
+}
